title: T1 · Polymarket crypto markets as a lead signal for BTC/ETH
decision: T1 fails: Polymarket crypto markets do not lead spot. Move to T2 (event shocks -> assets).

experiments.title: G0 · Data and alignment
experiments.question: Do we have enough crypto markets, and do their windows line up with the spot candles?
experiments.headline: 5239 markets with trades, 218,808 asset-minutes over 250 days; resolution matches Binance spot in 98.9% of markets that moved ≥ 2 bps (96.9% including near-ties).
notes: Pass rule: ≥ 500 markets with trades and ≥ 95% agreement between the resolution and Binance close ≥ open over the market window, on markets whose spot move was at least 2 bps (some markets settle on Chainlink prices, so exact ties can differ).
A window shift is applied only if it beats the documented window by 5+ points of agreement.

experiments.title: G1 · Does Polymarket lead spot?
experiments.question: Beyond what the spot path already says, does the Polymarket price predict the next spot return?
experiments.headline: At 5 min, adding Polymarket's view changes out-of-sample R² by -0.008% (95% CI -0.017% to +0.000%, 229 test days); daily rank correlation +0.017.
notes: Signal u = logit(Polymarket P(Up)) − logit(P(Up) implied by the spot path and recent volatility).
Walk-forward by day (≥ 21 training days); CI by resampling test days.
Pass rule: R² gain > 0 with the 95% CI above 0 at the main horizon; < 20 test days = inconclusive.

experiments.title: G2 · Do skilled wallets lead?
experiments.question: Does net buying by wallets with a proven record (judged only on earlier markets) predict spot?
experiments.headline: Skilled-wallet flow changes out-of-sample R² by -0.009% beyond plain flow (95% CI -0.033% to +0.013%); crypto wallet edge persistence ρ = 0.09 (2588 wallets).
notes: Top tier = top 10% of shrunk edge among wallets with ≥ 5 resolved crypto markets before the trade.
Pass rule: skilled flow's R² gain over plain flow > 0 with the 95% CI above 0.

experiments.title: G3 · Tradable after costs?
experiments.question: Trading spot when the model's signal is strong, entering one minute late and paying fees: is it profitable?
experiments.headline: Best rule (wallets) nets -6.01 bps per trade at 5 bps cost (95% CI -9.14 to -2.85, 137 trades).
notes: Threshold: top 10% of |signal| on earlier days only; one open position per asset.
Pass rule: any rule with mean net return > 0 and CI above 0 at 5 bps; 20 bps (retail taker fees) is reported too. < 100 trades = inconclusive.
